about_short_description.short_description: NABED is an innovative patient-centric digital platform that elevates patient engagement and empowers them to be participant in their care.

product.name: Waiting Room TV Channels
product.description: Digital TV channels for waiting rooms that provide department-specific health information and promote healthcare services to patients during wait times.

product.name: Consultation Clinical Engagement Tool
product.description: A tool used during patient consultations to enhance physician-patient interaction and improve adherence to personalized care plans.

product.name: Personalized Education Integrated with HIS/EMR
product.description: Automated delivery of personalized patient education based on medical codes integrated with hospital information and electronic medical record systems.

product.name: Content Management System for Educators
product.description: A platform that allows healthcare educators to design and customize patient educational journeys and monitor adherence post-discharge.

product.name: Outpatient Care Plan
product.description: A system to connect with patients throughout their care continuum, providing personalized guidance and monitoring to support self-care and compliance.

product.name: Patient-Reported Experience Measures (PREMs)
product.description: A tool to automate the collection and analysis of patient feedback on care experience to improve quality and satisfaction.
